# Internationalization

## Scope

Applies when the change touches more than one language or region. Not when the product ships one language to one region, and the i18n-ready default covers it. Neighbours: `aidd-team:web-front-end`, `aidd-team:product-defaults`, `aidd-team:technical-writing`.

## Standards

| # | Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | Unicode CLDR | CLDR 48 | 2026-10-02 | <https://cldr.unicode.org/> |
| S2 | BCP 47 language tags | RFC 5646, 2009 | 2026-09-30 | <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5646> |
| S3 | ICU MessageFormat, with MessageFormat 2 where the runtime has it | MessageFormat 2.0 (LDML 48) | 2026-09-30 | <https://unicode-org.github.io/icu/userguide/format_parse/messages/mf2.html> |
| S4 | W3C internationalization best practices | — | 2026-09-29 (reviewed) | <https://www.w3.org/International/techniques/authoring-html> |
| S5 | Translated documentation: XLIFF for exchange, gettext for source strings, and a translation memory that keeps glossary terms stable | XLIFF Core 2.1 | 2026-09-30 | <https://docs.oasis-open.org/xliff/xliff-core/v2.1/xliff-core-v2.1.html> |
| S6 | IANA Time Zone Database (tzdata) | 2026e | 2026-09-30 | <https://www.iana.org/time-zones> |
| S7 | Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm (UAX #9) | Revision 52 (Unicode 18.0.0) | 2026-10-02 | <https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr9/> |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd assess`) | A change that adds or reorders user-visible text, or formats dates, numbers, or names, touches every locale. | S1 |
| Entry (`aidd assess`) | Product defaults (`i18n_ready`): build each one `[project.defaults] off` does not name, as `aidd-team:product-defaults` says. | — |
| Specify | The locales in the Acceptance; text expansion, right-to-left, and pluralization cases named; the CLDR version the runtime ships, pinned. | S2, S3, S1 |
| Implement | No concatenated strings; ICU MessageFormat for plurals and gender (MessageFormat 2 only where the runtime's is stable); locale-aware formatting from CLDR; UTF-8 end to end. | S3, S1 |
| Implement | Instants stored in UTC, with the IANA zone id for local-time events. The tz data comes from a pinned, updated source, never a hand-kept offset table. | S6 |
| Review | No hard-coded locale, time zone, or encoding. User-supplied text is isolated (`dir=auto`, `<bdi>`, or FSI and PDI), so the bidi algorithm does not reorder what surrounds it. Pseudo-localization passes. | S4, S7 |
| Ship | Translation coverage per locale tracked; a missing string falls back visibly, never silently. | S5 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pseudo-localization build | no truncation or concatenation in any screen | a pseudo-locale build in CI: `npx @formatjs/cli@6.16.32 compile lang/en.json --pseudo-locale xx-LS --out-file lang/xx-LS.json`, or `pseudo-localization` (3.1.3) | S4 |
| Message-format lint | every message parses and has complete plural categories | `npx @formatjs/cli@6.16.32 verify "lang/*.json" --source-locale en --missing-keys --structural-equality`, or the stack's ICU message linter | S3 |
| Locale snapshot tests | dates, numbers, currencies, and names format per locale | snapshot tests over the supported locales | S1 |
| RTL layout tests | the changed screens mirror correctly | screenshot tests in an RTL locale | S4, S7 |
| Time-zone tests | local times stay right across DST changes and zone rule updates | unit tests at each DST transition of the supported zones, run against the pinned tz data | S6 |
| Translation coverage | every key exists in every shipped locale | a coverage check over the message catalogs | S5 |

## Keep it current

Each entry is due after its `review_every_days` (else emerging 90 days, established 365) or by its `review_due`. An emerging one applies only when the change needs it, said in the Spec. One `aidd eval standards` lists as due is looked up in Specify, and a missing one is proposed to aidd's `schemas/roles.json`. Steward: @thaithienvanid, who reviews every change to this pack's standards.
